world.note: OSM course boundary bbox (594 x 480 m, way 674855473) + at least 120 m of scenery, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks and centred (215 m west/east, 144 m south/north)

scorecard_source: PROVISIONAL, unverified: GolfPass (https://www.golfpass.com/courses/32096-bandon-preserve/scorecard-and-layout, retrieved 2026-10-22), Back and Front yardages, par 3 on every hole; golfingrecord.com gives the same yardages. Stroke index differs between the two (GolfPass 13,15,3,5,1,17,7,11,9,8,2,18,6, not a 1-13 set; golfingrecord 1,3,5,...); GolfPass's is stored until the resort's card arrives (requested 2026-10-22). No rating (par-3 course, stored 0). Built from the Back tees (no Blue; the longest set).
attribution: Elevation and canopy: Oregon Department of Geology and Mineral Industries (DOGAMI) lidar
Orthophoto: Oregon Statewide Imagery Program 2024 (gorse, tree and tee checks)
notes: Intake 2026-10-22 (built with Shorty's from shared downloads, release bandon-par-threes-data). Standing defaults (COURSE_BUILD.md 4.1): back tees (no Blue), all water red, OB = the OSM course polygon, trees from lidar with trees_off_fairways_m 2; wind 8-16 mph as the developer set for Bandon Dunes; theme bandon_dunes with gorse from the 2024 photo, as at Bandon Dunes. Provisional until the rasters arrive; lake_level_max_m / cliff keys copied from Old Macdonald, to be checked against this DTM.
tree_type_note: the trees on the bluffs at Bandon are shore pine (and Sitka spruce in the hollows), whose broad wind-flattened crowns the crown-shape rule calls deciduous; the broadleaf scrub is drawn as gorse (as at Bandon Dunes)

gorse.note: as at Bandon Dunes (developer 2026-10-20): thickets from the OSIP 2024 orthophoto (pipeline/gorse.py); the ground under them is the gorse surface (17)

trees_need_ortho.note: the DOGAMI lidar here was flown in 2008, older than parts of the course; lidar trees whose crowns are not dark canopy in the OSIP 2024 photo are dropped
